title: Sandbox Craft
description: Minecraft mod heavily inspired by People Playground.
body: Welcome to Sandbox Craft, expanding on Minecraft's sandbox aspect!  Experiment with a sandbox dimension, use guns, find new structures, and so much more!  This mod will also evolve the exploration part of Minecraft, adding new structures, new items, and it can go on.  So try out this mod today, see for yourself and find so much more!
